name: MCB 3022W
title: Human Disease and the Development of Therapeutic Agents
description: Molecular basis of human disease and strategies for developing therapeutic treatments. Applications of genetic, cellular, and biochemical information in treating disease states. Especially appropriate for students interested in biomedical research and the health profession.
requirement_description: ENGL 1007 or 1010 or 1011. Recommended preparation: one 2000-level MCB course.
